bullets.text: Curbing Freeholder Obstruction - The UK government consults on easing fibre rollout to flats, targeting 1.2 million underserved homes.
AI Predicts Customer Churn - Telecoms leverage AI to proactively identify and retain at-risk customers, enhancing service quality.
Ofcom Approves Satellite Services - Mobile operators can now offer direct-to-device satellite services, enhancing connectivity in remote areas.
Vodafone's IoT Hyperscale Strategy - Vodafone aims for global IoT leadership through partnerships and platform simplification in the Americas.
AI-RAN Optimisation Validated - Samsung and KT demonstrate AI-driven network adaptability, improving service quality in real-time.
AI Boom Challenges Networks - Nokia warns existing infrastructure may not support rising AI workloads, urging urgent upgrades.
Data Privacy in AI Era - Telecoms face challenges balancing data monetisation with privacy concerns as AI integration deepens.
World Communication Awards 2025 - Celebrating innovation, Singtel and Ericsson win for 5G advancements and network slicing.
